semanticAndStyleSelfReview.method: Owner read all current Japanese source fields, translated directly from Japanese, compared source versus target and reread every target paragraph as connected respectful adult teaching prose, plus all7lesson metadata sets and7questions/28specific rationales. Own prior Japanese-bound map checked with0conflicts and0current paragraph matches. No other-locale semantic input/pivot/cross-review. Counts, revisions and hashes support binding checks but do not certify meaning or independent approval.
checks: Reserve goods present in bag versus usable power/device state distinguished; institution-set checks, storage knowledge/retrieval delay, cash/documents support/info purpose and institution roles/privacy/money controls retained. Individual mobility/hearing aid/usual care/current medicine needs not satisfied by one common bag. Name/count, unusable reason/missing goods/replenishment owner/next check recorded; expiry/specification mismatch not usable stock, unchecked remains unchecked. Radio mismatched battery and individual hearing-aid supplies unknown separately handed over. No universal type/count, actual response plan/person need, exact responsible-person or healthcare recipient for medicines and no list-only dose/type changes.

Body left/right anchored to person not facing-worker view. Ascending colon normally person right upward, transverse across, descending left downward retained; right lower→upper→left→left lower is anatomy relation practice, not pressing force/time/count/permission. Abdominal-pain location/start/person words recorded to healthcare professional or instructional responsible person, no direction-only cause or abdominal-force procedure. Pregnancy/IBD/abdominal surgery/wounds important consultation conditions, not alone suitability decision; professional person-fit confirmation retained.

Scrotum outside sac versus testis gland inside versus foreskin covering glans at penis tip retained without mixing names. Unclear target/action not guessed from similar name, pull direction/force not inferred, unknown action not begun and instructional responsible person/healthcare worker consulted. Pain/resistance no forced continuation and condition conveyed. Embarrassment/privacy/no unnecessary public exposure/no unrelated sharing; exact site/person words/unknowns to necessary recipient separate. Source male wiping movement not certified safe here, personal genital hygiene procedure requires professional/institution guidance.

QOL includes own satisfaction/happiness/purpose/mental richness, not staff task count alone. Ask personal activity meaning and words, not staff tastes/satisfaction substitute. Movement independence versus own choice, help for hands not loss of activity/time/role choice, help amount not satisfaction/intent proof. Paragraph photo count and question completed-book count intentionally retain their respective Japanese source fields; own memory-sharing wish separately recorded and asked again. Unsuitable activity/current wish/difficult part to team, not more tasks for attractive record; wishes/ability/safety review, no one-answer diagnosis or solo plan change.

Community/group participation includes own wish/method/role rather than same venue alone; care receiver can engage through experience/strengths and contribute, need for help not inability to contribute. Identify difficulty with person, discuss method/support using own wishes/ability, neither force same method nor exclude for difficult part. Recorded-audio book example preserves content-sharing wish, no print-reading-only presentation restriction, ask desired method/preparation/process. Not all activities suit everyone, actual need/ability/place/operation conditions and own/responsible-person consultation retained.

Service classification by care location and who travels: worker visits home, person attends daytime center, resident lives in institution. Established home-care/day-care/service/care-plan specialist terms retained. Vehicle/staff alone not type, return home versus residence checked. Same person needs vary by period/time, actual person/date-time/place/content confirmed and undecided points separate; name alone not schedule. Classification not personal eligibility/insurance/price/facility choice; own wish and responsible-person/care-plan specialist consultation govern actual adjustment.

Care plan links desired life/goals/support; staff actions alone not desired result. Implementation record versus personal response/outcome/goal progress separate, staff verbal contacts not goal achievement. Three guidance attempts and person not understanding choices retained, no actual informed choice/goal achieved inferred. Revisit information, explanation/participation conditions and goal suitability with team, no blame for assumed lack of effort. Evaluate for person-fit support not score/count, record actual action/response/unknowns and share with person/responsible, actual goal/help changes not solo decision.

All7lesson metadata and all28distinct option-specific rationales complete, with exact actors/recipients/conditions/negation/uncertainty/sequence/individual-plan/training/product/clinical limits. All7reading fields remain explicit empty strings. Adult respectful address without invented gender/age/family relation; anatomical Japanese learning labels retain readings.0figure captions and no UI/artwork changes.
